t: 苏格兰的詹姆斯六世被封为英格兰和爱尔兰国王詹姆斯一世,伊丽莎白一世去世后即位.
te: James VI of Scotland is proclaimed King James I of England and Ireland, upon the death of Elizabeth I.
dz: 苏格兰的詹姆斯六世被封为英格兰和爱尔兰国王詹姆斯一世,伊丽莎白一世去世后即位.
de: James VI of Scotland is proclaimed King James I of England and Ireland, upon the death of Elizabeth I.

t: 德川家康被后阳正天皇授予将军称号，并在日本江户建立德川幕府。
te: Tokugawa Ieyasu is granted the title of shōgun from Emperor Go-Yōzei, and establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Edo, Ja…
dz: 德川家康被后阳正天皇授予将军称号，并在日本江户建立德川幕府。
de: Tokugawa Ieyasu is granted the title of shōgun from Emperor Go-Yōzei, and establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Edo, Japan.

t: 詹姆斯六世和一世与丹麦的安妮被加冕于威斯敏斯特修道院.
te: James VI and I and Anne of Denmark are crowned in Westminster Abbey.
dz: 詹姆斯六世和一世与丹麦的安妮被加冕于威斯敏斯特修道院.
de: James VI and I and Anne of Denmark are crowned in Westminster Abbey.

t: 英国探险家,作家和侍从沃尔特·拉利爵士因叛国罪受审.
te: English explorer, writer and courtier Sir Walter Raleigh goes on trial for treason.
dz: 英国探险家,作家和侍从沃尔特·拉利爵士因叛国罪受审.
de: English explorer, writer and courtier Sir Walter Raleigh goes on trial for treason.
